responsive.desktop: A centered two-row top masthead places the approved SkyyRose graphic above a miniature engraved Cinzel collection label. The title, price/availability, hover narrative, variant chips, and actions share the same card axis. Fine-pointer hover/focus reveals only the WooCommerce short description and available purchasable variation attributes; cards with that reveal do not start a competing reel. Simple-product quick add has a localized, initiating-card-only success state; after eight seconds without confirmation, its own CTA becomes a non-retryable pending state that directs the customer to check the bag.
responsive.mobile: The top masthead remains centered with a compact graphic and miniature collection label. The action stack is single-column with no hover dependence; a native Piece details disclosure exposes the same read-only short description and available-variant summary for touch users. The statue frame uses responsive srcset and contain crop. Copy and metadata keep a bounded centered measure, while controls remain full-width and meet the touch-target rule. The canonical PDP retains the full product description and variation selector.
responsive.reducedMotion: No reel timer or transition dependency; hover-detail content remains a nonessential progressive disclosure and all verified media and actions remain visible.

accessibility: meaningful product image alt is product name
local action result uses role=status aria-live=polite aria-atomic=true
direct PDP link remains available in every rendered state
hover disclosure has a keyboard focus equivalent; touch uses a native details/summary fallback, and neither presentation hosts a variant selector
brand mark is decorative while the adjacent collection lockup remains visible

e2e.mutationRule: requires an approved disposable staging product fixture and allowMutations=true
